q1.explanationZh: 男孩问是不是像平时一样吃三明治，妈妈提议这次烧烤；男孩又想去咖啡馆吃炸鱼薯条，妈妈说八个人吃太贵，最后男孩说“你的主意不错”，也就是烧烤。B 错：炸鱼薯条太贵了；C 错：三明治是他们平时吃的。

q2.explanationZh: 女孩说老师把她的名字报在了曲棍球（hockey）名单上，所以这学期她要打曲棍球。A 错：这学期打排球的是男孩；C 错：篮球是男孩的建议，女孩说可以下学期再打。

q3.explanationZh: Bella 说去图书馆之前，她要先去店里取新眼镜，所以先去眼镜店。B 错：咖啡馆在眼镜店隔壁，取完眼镜才去；C 错：图书馆是最后才去的。

q4.explanationZh: Amy 说冬天骑车太辛苦，所以现在早点出门走路去上学。A 错：她只坐过一次公交车，而且太吵了；B 错：骑车是她以前的方式。

q5.explanationZh: 女孩提议买集市上的银耳环，男孩又说可以买手镯，女孩说妈妈不常戴手镯，于是男孩说“就买你建议的吧”，也就是耳环。A 错：项链是去年送的；C 错：妈妈不常戴手镯。

q6.explanationZh: Mandy 说妈妈不让她带吉他，所以请朋友带上风筝（bring your kite）。吉他是干扰项。

q7.explanationZh: Mandy 的妈妈不喜欢在沙滩上吃饭，但那里有一个公园（park），他们会在那里吃午饭。购物中心是午饭后才可能去的地方。

q8.explanationZh: 上次去海滩时他们踢了足球，这次 Mandy 订的是排球（volleyball）。football 是上次的运动。

q9.explanationZh: 坐船平时要 4.50 英镑，但周日打折，只要 3.75 英镑（three seventy-five）。4.50 是平时的价格。

q10.explanationZh: 他们 5:15 离开海滩，6:30（six thirty）回到 Mandy 家；6:45 是她家平时吃晚饭的时间。

q11.explanationZh: Ned 说很高兴他们第一节课就坐在一起，虽然两人住在同一条街上，以前却从没见过，所以是在课上第一次见面。A 错：住在同一条街却没在路上遇见过；C 错：午饭时间只是很开心。

q12.explanationZh: Ned 问 Aisha 开学前担不担心，Aisha 说其实很兴奋，Ned 说“我也是，一点都不害怕”。A 错：他说 not scared at all；C 错：lucky 是他哥哥说他们能上这所学校很幸运。

q13.explanationZh: Aisha 说她喜欢所有的老师，老师们做了很多事帮助他们，Ned 说 That's true，两人都同意老师很好。B 错：Aisha 说不是每个同学都好；C 错：Aisha 说教学楼看起来不怎么样。

q14.explanationZh: Aisha 说历史是她唯一不太喜欢的科目。A 错：地理现在是她最喜欢的；B 错：数学是她在以前学校最喜欢的科目。

q15.explanationZh: Ned 说他以前的学校作业没那么多，Aisha 说她以前的学校作业也很少，两人都认为以前作业更少。B 错：只有 Ned 说要写两小时，Aisha 只花一小时；C 错：只有 Aisha 说作业不难。

q16.explanationZh: 男孩说这本书是昨天作为奖品得到的，因为他在跑步比赛中得了第一。A 错：他看完后要把书借给 cousin（表亲），书不是从家人那里借来的；C 错：他在书店看过，但钱不够没买。

q17.explanationZh: 女孩说老师讲了很久手要放在哪里，手指放的位置不同就能弹出不同的声音，弹完手指很疼，爸爸也说到 instrument（乐器），所以是吉他课。B、C 错：网球和舞蹈都不是乐器。

q18.explanationZh: 这个夏天去奶奶家的人太多，男孩只能在奶奶的花园里露营（camp），也就是住帐篷。A 错：奶奶的房子住不下；B 错：把房子改成酒店只是一句玩笑。

q19.explanationZh: 老师让每个人和同伴比较自己写的答案，一起检查谁对，也就是两人一组检查练习。A 错：数学题大家已经做完了；B 错：讲图形的下一部分是之后才开始的。

q20.explanationZh: 男孩邀请女孩周六和他们一起去森林散步，女孩说 Brilliant，同意了。A 错：骑车只是女孩去男孩家的方式；B 错：他们说的是采蘑菇和留下吃晚饭，没有说一起做特别的食物。

q21.explanationZh: Sally 喜欢历史，打算带人参观小镇并给他们讲解，所以想当导游（tour guide）。G 错：teacher 是说 Alex 的爸爸。

q22.explanationZh: 妈妈问 Peter 是不是要帮爸爸照看他们的动物，男孩说对，所以 Peter 想当农民（farmer）。B 错：Peter 只是喜欢做饭，想当厨师的是 Tom。

q23.explanationZh: Amy 吉他弹得很好，但她真正想做的是教孩子们跳舞，所以是老师（teacher）。F 错：她会弹吉他，但不想当音乐家。

q24.explanationZh: Tom 钢琴弹得很好，但他喜欢待在厨房，希望将来在酒店做饭，所以想当厨师（chef）。F 错：弹钢琴只是他的特长。

q25.explanationZh: 妈妈猜喜欢帮助别人的 Jane 想当医生，男孩说“其实”她想整天看别人的牙齿，也就是当牙医（dentist）。D 错：医生只是妈妈的猜测。

content.v: Test One. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. What will they have for lunch?
Are we having sandwiches for our family lunch on the beach, Mum?
We usually do that, I know. Why don’t we have a barbecue this time?
Or perhaps some fish and chips at the café there? They always smell fantastic.
You’re right, but that’ll be quite expensive for eight of us.
OK. Your idea sounds good.
Two. Which sport is the girl going to play this term?
This term I’m doing volleyball for the first time. How about you?
I really enjoy volleyball – you will too. But my teacher’s put my name on the list for hockey, and I’m not sure I’ll like it.
Maybe not. I think basketball’s a good sport for you. You’re tall and run really fast.
Well, perhaps I can do that another term!
Three. Where will the friends go first?
Shall we work on our project together at the city library this afternoon, Bella?
OK, Matt, but before that I’ve got to collect my new glasses from the shop.
That’s no problem – because then we can go to that café next door. They sell great cakes.
Good idea. And it’s only ten minutes to walk to the library from there.
Four. How does the girl get to school now?
You’re looking well, Amy! Are you still riding your bike to school?
Well, it’s really good exercise for me, Uncle Jack, I know, but it’s hard in winter. So I’ve started leaving home early and walking there. I caught the bus once, but it was so noisy!
The bus is much faster.
But slower than by bike actually.
Five. What do they decide to buy for their mother?
What shall we get Mum for her birthday this year?
Well, she loved the necklace we got her last year. How about some other jewellery? I saw some nice silver earrings at the market.
Mm. That’s not a bad idea. Or we could buy a bracelet?
She doesn’t often wear those.
OK, then. Let’s get what you suggested.
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a girl called Mandy leaving a phone message for a friend about spending Sunday at the beach.
Hi! I’m ringing about going to the beach on Sunday. There’s no train that day, but there’s a bus which stops outside the beach café, so we’re getting that.
I wanted to take my guitar but Mum says no – so bring your kite instead please.
For lunch, we’re going to have a picnic. My mum doesn’t like eating on the beach but there’s a park. We’ll eat there and perhaps go to the shopping centre afterwards for half an hour.

Last time we were at the beach, we had a football match, remember? This time I’ve booked for us to play volleyball! It’ll be fun. We can go on a boat trip too. A ticket is usually four pounds fifty, but there’s a discount on Sunday and it’s only three seventy-five. That’s nearly a pound cheaper.
You’re invited to dinner at my house. We’ll leave the beach at quarter past five. Then we’ll be back at my place at six thirty which is great because my family usually eat at quarter to seven.
Bye!
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear two friends, Ned and Aisha, talking about their first week at a new school.
So, Ned. What did you think of our first week at the new school?
OK. I’m so happy we sat next to each other in our first class, Aisha. We live in the same street so I’m surprised we haven’t met before.
Yes, and lunchtime was fun.
Did you feel a bit worried before you started at the new school?
I felt excited actually.
Me too. Not scared at all. My brother says we’re lucky because it’s an awesome school.
Well, the building doesn’t look great.
I know, but all the kids in our class are lovely.
Most are but not everyone. But I like all our teachers. They do lots to help us.
That’s true. Which subject do you like best?
In my old school it was maths but geography’s my favourite now. History’s the only subject I don’t enjoy much.
The only thing I don’t like is homework. It takes at least two hours every evening.
Really? I only spend an hour. It’s not usually very difficult.
Well, we didn’t get so much in my old school.
We got very little at mine as well.
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear two friends talking about a book. How did the boy get the book?
Oh, I’ve read that book. It’s really good.

It’s strange – I was looking at it in a bookshop a few days ago, but didn’t have enough money to get it. So I was really pleased when it was given to me as a prize yesterday. I was first in the running race!
Fantastic!
I’ll lend it to my cousin after I’ve read it.
Seventeen. You will hear a girl talking to her father about a lesson. What type of lesson did she have?
How was your first lesson?
It was OK, Dad, but the teacher spent ages talking about our hands, and where we have to put them.
Well, the way you hold an instrument is important, isn’t it?
Yeah. And you can make lots of different sounds, depending on where you put your fingers. But playing is difficult. My fingers really hurt afterwards!
Eighteen. You will hear a boy telling his friend about his next holiday. Where will the boy stay on holiday?
I’m really looking forward to my holiday. We’re going to France again.
Your grandmother has a house there, hasn’t she?
Yeah, but there are so many of us visiting her this summer that I’ll have to camp in her garden.
Well, it’s fun to sleep outside. If her house is so popular, she should turn it into a hotel!
That’s what she says!
Nineteen. You will hear a teacher talking to his class. What does he want his class to do now?

OK, you’ve now each prepared answers to the maths questions. I’d like you to work with a partner and compare what you wrote. If you haven’t got the same answers, look at your work carefully together and decide who’s right. Then we’ll discuss things as a class before starting the next section in your book – that’s all about shapes.
Twenty. You will hear two friends talking about their plans for Saturday. What are they going to do together on Saturday?
My cousin’s visiting my family this weekend. We’re going to have a walk in the forest with my mum. Would you like to join us for that on Saturday?
Brilliant, I’ll cycle over to yours after breakfast on Saturday. The forest is lovely in autumn and it’s the perfect time for collecting mushrooms.
Then stay and have dinner with us.
Thanks.
That is the end of Part Four.
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear a boy telling his mum about the jobs his friends would like to do. Which job would each friend like to do?
How was your day?
Interesting, we talked about what we want to do after we leave school.
I know Alex’s dad is a teacher. Is that what he wants to be?
That’s what everyone in our class thought, but he goes to the theatre a lot – and wants to be in plays.
And Sally?
Well, she loves history – she’s going to show people our town and tell them about it. The visitors will learn lots!
What about Peter? Is he going to help his dad look after all their animals?
That’s right – I hope he still has time for cooking – he loves it!
And Amy’s so good at playing the guitar.
I know, but she really wants to help children learn how to dance.
What about Tom? He plays the piano really well.
Yes, and loves being in the kitchen. He hopes to make the meals in a hotel.
And what about, Jane? She likes helping people. Does she want to be a doctor?
Actually, she’d like to spend all day looking at people’s teeth!
Great!
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
